units: <cite ref="Yevamot 66b:9">Yeb. 66ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>מחוסר ג׳</he> wanting collection (not yet collected).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 110b">B. Mets. 110ᵇ</cite> landed property <he>כיון דלג׳ קיימא וכ׳</he> because it is ready to be collected from, (is seizable for debts and cannot be hidden), is considered as if collected.
